name: anatomy_monster_shifting_shape_013

source_visual_profile.source_description: An animate blotch of conflicting symmetries, erratically hovering through the air.  It's not even real enough to hold a stable shape, and its entire form is constantly in flux.  You can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.
source_visual_profile.classifier: Explicit per-ID design after reading the primary-source monster descriptions.
